//env: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is deliberately NOT set here. It is baked into the bundle at build
time, and this repo is public — committing the backend URL next to a README that already
publishes the demo password is what would turn a walkthrough into an open door.
Set it on the EAS project instead, once:
The build reads it from there. Without it the app falls back to localhost and will look
broken on the recipient's phone, so check `eas env:list` before shipping a build.

preview-simulator.//: Runs in the iOS Simulator without an Apple Developer account. Useful for checking a real build before paying for one.

submit.//: Deliberately empty. Demo PRD section 6 rules out App Store and Play Store submission — the deliverable is an Expo Go session or an internal preview link.
